story.p1: {{full}} began with a moment of pride. {{founder}} watched close associates start their own companies and saw first-hand how much courage it takes to begin.
story.p2: That moment stayed with him. He has long been passionate about helping SMMEs reach their goals, to develop and to grow, and he wanted to build something that stands beside them while they do.
story.p3: The name is the message he wanted to send to his close associates, and to every business and organisation that uses it: you are capable. Keep pushing, and never stop.
story.title: Our story

about.tagline: The CRM that brings your business, your customers and your team together.

hero.body: Running a business takes courage, determination and hard work. Managing it shouldn't make the journey harder.
hero.promise: At YGT, we believe every entrepreneur deserves tools that make everyday business simpler, clearer and more manageable. Because when you have the right support behind you, you can focus on what matters: building something meaningful.
hero.supporting: Grow your opportunities. Manage your operations. Succeed on your terms.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To give businesses accessible, reliable and intelligent technology that simplifies their work, lifts productivity and supports lasting growth.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To be a trusted technology partner for businesses across South Africa and beyond, helping entrepreneurs turn ambition into businesses that last.

grow.title: Grow
grow.body: Build stronger customer relationships, find new opportunities and move sales forward with a clear view of your pipeline.

manage.title: Manage
manage.body: Keep your everyday work together: customers, quotes, invoices, products, activities and messages.

succeed.title: Succeed
succeed.body: Stay informed, make better decisions and keep moving towards your goals. Success looks different for every business; YGT helps you focus on yours.

builtFor.title: Built for businesses of all sizes
builtFor.body: Whether you're starting your first business, running a growing company or leading a bigger team, YGT is built to support your journey. Powerful business tools should be practical and approachable, not reserved for large organisations.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Useful business tools should be within everyone's reach.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.body: We keep finding smarter ways to solve everyday challenges.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.body: Technology you can depend on, every day.

empowerment.title: Empowerment
empowerment.body: Helping entrepreneurs act with confidence and keep growing.

sa.title: For a brighter, stronger South Africa
sa.body: South African entrepreneurs face their own challenges. YGT brings practical tools and ways of working that suit local businesses, in all 11 official languages, so you can compete, grow and succeed in a digital economy.

promise.title: Your journey. Our commitment.
promise.body: Building a business isn't always easy, but you don't have to face every challenge alone. We're here to simplify your work so you can focus on your goals.

smsSteps.account: Open an account with BulkSMS, Clickatell or Twilio and buy some credit.
smsSteps.keys: Create API keys in the provider's dashboard and paste them below.
smsSteps.sender: Add the sender ID or number your provider approved (many South African networks need a registered sender ID).
smsSteps.webhook: Save, test with your own number, then set the webhook URL shown below as the provider's inbound SMS address.

webhookHelp.sms: In your SMS provider's dashboard, set this as the address for incoming messages (inbound / reply webhook) so replies reach YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Paste these into Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, then subscribe to "messages". This is how customer replies reach YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Connect your own WhatsApp Business number through Meta's official Cloud API. Messages go out from your number and replies come into Messages.

whatsappSteps.app: Go to developers.facebook.com, create an app of type Business and add the WhatsApp product.
whatsappSteps.ids: Under WhatsApp > API Setup, add your business phone number and copy its Phone number ID and WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Paste them below, tick "Use WhatsApp", save, then test with your own cellphone number.
whatsappSteps.token: In Business Settings > System users, create a permanent access token with the whatsapp_business_messaging permission.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Copy the webhook URL and verify token shown after saving into Meta's webhook settings.
whatsappSteps.window: WhatsApp rule: you can reply freely for 24 hours after a customer messages you; starting a chat after that needs a Meta-approved template.

card.q: Do I need a card to try it?
card.a: No. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. You only add a card when you choose a plan.

vat.q: Are the invoices ready for SARS?
vat.a: Yes. Your VAT number and your client's appear on quotes and tax invoices, with the total excl. VAT, the VAT and the total incl. VAT.

import.q: Can I bring my existing customers?
import.a: Yes. Import customers, products and deals from a spreadsheet or another CRM in a few minutes.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes. YGT works in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer, so you can quote from a client's site.

data.a: Each company's data is kept private and separate from every other company's, in line with POPIA, and you can export it any time.

help.a: Log a support ticket in the app, or book a free video session with our team.

problems.title: Sound familiar?
problems.intro: Most small businesses run on WhatsApp, notebooks and spreadsheets. It works, until the business grows.

leads.problem: Enquiries get lost in WhatsApp. A client asks for a price and nobody follows up.
leads.fix: Every enquiry becomes a customer and a deal on your pipeline, with a reminder to follow up.

quotes.problem: Quotes take an evening to type up, and each one looks different.
quotes.fix: Pick your products and send a professional quote with your logo and VAT details in minutes.

paid.problem: “Has this been paid?” You're checking the bank and old emails.
paid.fix: Accepted quotes become tax invoices, payment reminders go out for you, and you can see who owes you.

scattered.problem: Five spreadsheets and three versions of the truth.
scattered.fix: One place for the whole team, on any phone or computer. Bring your customers in from Excel.

intro.title: How organised is your business, really?
intro.lead: 10 quick questions about how you run things today. Discover what's slowing your business down, where you could save time, and how to simplify your daily operations.

customers.problem: Your customer details are spread across {{tools}}, so finding the right number or history takes time.
customers.fix: One customer list with every contact, quote, invoice and conversation, searchable by your whole team.

problem.memory: Enquiries live in your head, so when it gets busy, some go cold before anyone follows up.
problem.whatsapp: Enquiries stay buried in WhatsApp chats, so it's hard to see what's waiting or what each one is worth.
problem.excel: Enquiries sit in a spreadsheet that someone has to keep up to date, and some still slip through.
problem.crm: You track enquiries, but some still slip through the cracks before they become jobs.

pipeline.fix: A pipeline that shows every enquiry from first message to won job, with the next step and its value.

tasks.problem: Follow-ups rely on {{tools}}. When someone is busy or away, things get missed.
tasks.fix: Tasks with due dates, checklists and reminders, assigned to the right person so nothing depends on memory.

documents.problem: Quotes and invoices are made in {{tools}}: typed up by hand, numbered by hand, and hard to follow up.
documents.fix: Professional quotes in minutes that turn into invoices in one click, with VAT, numbering and your branding done for you.

problem.rarely: Late payments are rare, but nothing is watching for them, so the odd one can sit for months.
problem.manual: You chase late payers yourself, one call or message at a time. It costs hours and awkward conversations.
problem.remember: Late payers are chased only when you remember, so money you've earned sits outstanding.
problem.automatic: Payments are followed up, but it's hard to see at a glance who owes you what.

payments.fix: See who owes you at a glance, and let automatic reminders follow up on overdue invoices for you.

report.scoreNote: This measures how organised the processes we asked about are, not how well your business is doing. Your business may be doing well: the score just shows where daily processes could be easier.

attention.label: Needs attention
attention.title: A lot of everyday admin still runs on memory and manual work
attention.body: Based on your answers, several everyday processes rely on manual tracking and separate tools. These are the easiest gaps to close, and {{name}} was built for exactly this.

progress.label: Making progress
progress.title: You've got the basics, but some things still slip
progress.body: Some processes run well, others depend on memory and manual work. Bringing them together in {{name}} could free up real time every month.

organised.label: Well organised
organised.title: You're well organised. Now make it effortless
organised.body: You already have good habits. {{name}} can put the remaining pieces in one place, so admin takes even less time.

high.label: Highly organised
high.title: Your processes are in great shape
high.body: You don't urgently need to change how you work. If you'd like everything in one place, {{name}} can still help, but you're already doing well.

toolsCost.some: {{loose}} of them are loose tools that are only partly connected, so some things still get copied across by hand: {{points}} points off. Systems like a CRM or an invoicing app don't count against you.
toolsCost.manual: {{loose}} of them are loose tools you copy information between by hand, so things fall through the gaps: {{points}} points off. Systems like a CRM or an invoicing app don't count against you.
toolsCost.unsure: {{loose}} of them are loose tools, and you're not sure what's copied between them, so things can fall through the gaps: {{points}} points off. Systems like a CRM or an invoicing app don't count against you.

report.toolsFine: That's a manageable number. Keeping it there pays off.
report.noGaps: No big gaps found. Nicely done.
report.how: An estimate, not a promise, based only on your answers. Each quote or invoice takes 8 to 25 minutes depending on where it's made, against {{ygt}} to {{lowYgt}} minutes with {{name}}. Chasing a late invoice by hand takes about {{chase}} minutes. Copying between loose tools costs up to {{switching}} hours a month per person for every tool past two, less if your tools are partly connected and nothing if they work together; some copying stays with {{name}} too. Looking things up is counted separately, so no minute is counted twice. Lookup time grows with the number of people handling admin, but more slowly than the team. The top of the range is your time now minus the time estimated with {{name}}; the bottom assumes you move about half, at {{lowYgt}} minutes a document. Every loose tool past {{ok}} costs up to 2 points, and the score runs from 0 to 100.
report.trialTitle: Ready to make running your business easier?
report.trialBody: You've seen where your processes could improve. Try {{name}} free for {{days}} days and put everything in one place. No card needed, cancel any time.
report.worthNote: At your hourly value. This is the value of time freed up, not guaranteed extra income or cash savings. Your results depend on how much of your work you move across.
report.toolsConnected: You said your tools work together, so the number of tools doesn't cost you points.
report.rangeHigh: {{hours}} h if you move all of this into {{name}}.
report.rangeLow: {{hours}} h if you move about half of it, and each quote or invoice still takes {{minutes}} minutes.

customers.title: Put your customers in one place
customers.body: Bring every number, email and history into one list everyone can search, instead of phones, chats and notebooks.

pipeline.title: Write down every enquiry
pipeline.body: Give each enquiry a stage and a next step the day it arrives, so nobody goes quiet without you noticing.

tasks.title: Give every follow-up a date and an owner
tasks.body: Move to-dos out of memory and chats into one list with due dates and reminders.

documents.title: Make quoting consistent
documents.body: Use saved products, prices and customer details, so every quote looks the same and becomes an invoice without retyping.

payments.title: Set up a reminder routine
payments.body: Check who owes you every week and send reminders on a fixed schedule, so chasing doesn't depend on remembering.

roadmap.footer: You don't have to fix everything at once. Start with step 1.
